HEADLINE: This is in continuation to our earlier outcome dated November 12, 2026 , the Company approved a Rights Issue of up to 57,05,412 (Fifty-Seven Lakh Five Thousand Four Hundred and Twelve) ....
MORE: This is in continuation to our earlier outcome dated November 12, 2026 , the Company approved a Rights Issue of up to 57,05,412 (Fifty-Seven Lakh Five Thousand Four Hundred and Twelve) fully paid up Equity Shares of face value of ?10/- each (Rupees Ten only) ('Rights Equity Shares ') of the Company at an issue price of ? 41/ - (Rupees Forty One only) per Rights Equity Share (including a premium of ? 31 per Equity Share) aggregating up to an amount of Rs. 24,00,00,000/- (Rupees Twenty-Four Crore only) on rights basis to the Eligible Equity Shareholders of the Company in the ratio of 34 Rights Equity Shares for every 100 Equity Shares held by the Eligible Equity Shareholders as on the record date i.e. November 18, 2026, the copy of the Letter of Offer in terms of Regulation 71(2) of SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, as amended is enclosed herewith.
